intro.text: A woman from a village in Natanatan long ago, whom Dalinar meets in one of his visions.

items.text: When the Midnight Essence attacked her village, Taffa stayed home while her husband Heb searched for their daughter Seeli. In Dalinar's vision "Heb" returned with Seeli and killed a monster, and Taffa was bewildered by his sudden skill and his not knowing his own family.
Taffa fled toward a river with Heb and Seeli but was surrounded until two Knights Radiant rescued them. She asked one to heal Heb's strange memory, and then the Almighty spoke through her to Dalinar.
When someone else lived the same vision, "Heb" left her to rally a resistance and she was killed in her home, which is likely what really happened to her.

appearance.text: A middle-aged woman with curly black hair.

personality.text: Caring and cautious, she prefers fleeing to fighting and keeps her wits under threat. She worships the Heralds and the Three Gods and deeply respects the Knights Radiant.
